senses.gloss:
वक् वक् (a form of rt. वङ्क्, q. v.), to go
crookedly, &c., (in Ṛg-veda VII. 21, 3.
वावक्रे = निर्गच्छन्ति, they issued forth.)

वक्क् वक्क् [cf. rts. वष्क्, वस्क्, वङ्क्],
cl. 1. A. वक्कते, वक्कितुम्, to go.

वक, अस्, m. a heron, crane, Ardea Nivea; a
hypocrite, cheat, rogue, deceiver (the crane being
regarded as an animal of great cunning and deceit
as well as sagacity); a particular tree, Sesbana Gran-
diflora; an apparatus for calcining or subliming
metals or minerals (consisting of two crucibles, one
inverted over the other and placed over a fire); N.
of a Ṛṣi (having the patronymic Dālbhi or Dālbhya);
of a Rākṣasa or demon (killed by Bhīma or Bhīma-
sena, see वक-वध); of an Asura (said to have
assumed the form of a crane and to have been con-
quered by Kṛṣṇa); of Kuvera; of a king; (आस्),
m. pl., N. of a people; (ई), f. = पूतना.
—वक-
कच्छ, N. of a district.
—वक-कल्प, अस्, m., N.
of a particular Kalpa or period of the world.
—वक-
चर, अस्, m. = वक-व्रतिन्.
—वक-चिञ्चिका, f. a
sort of fish.
—वक-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of Vaka,’
N. of Bhīma-sena.
—वक-त्व, अम्, n. the state or
condition of a crane.
—वक-द्वीप, अस्, m., N. of
a Dvīpa.
—वक-धूप, अस्, m. a compound per-
fume, (also read वृक-धूप.)
—वक-नख, अस्,
m., N. of a son of Viśvā-mitra, (also read वक-नक.)
—वक-निसूदन, अस्, m. ‘destroyer of Vaka,’ N.
of Bhīma-sena.
—वक-पञ्चक, अम्, n. a space of
time consisting of the last five Tithis of the bright
half of the month Kārttika.
—वक-पुष्प, अस्,
m. a kind of tree, Æschynomene Grandiflora; (अम्),
n. the flower of this tree.
—वक-यन्त्र, अम्, n.
‘crane-like instrument,’ epithet of a particular form
of retort.
—वक-राज, अस्, m. the king of the cranes
(named Rāja-dharman, he was son of Kaśyapa, see
Mahā-bh. Śānti-p. 6336).
—वक-वध, अस्, m.
‘the killing of Vaka,’ N. of a section of the Ādi-
parvan of the Mahā-bh. 6103-6315 (describing
how Bhīma, while resident in the city of Eka-cakrā,
delivered his family and the whole neighbourhood
[]
from the tyranny of the demon named Vaka or
Baka, who forced the citizens to send him every day
a dish of food by a man whom he always devoured
as his daintiest morsel at the end of the repast).
—वक-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a kind of tree.
—वक-
वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, one who acts or behaves like a crane,
hypocritical; (इस्), m. a false or hypocritical devotee,
hypocrite (compared to the crane which stations itself
cunningly by a pool apparently absorbed in meditation
till it sees a fish on which to dart).
—वक-वैरिन्,
ई, m. ‘Vaka's enemy,’ N. of Bhīma-sena.
—वक-
व्रत, अम्, n. ‘crane-like observance,’ the conduct
of a crane, hypocrisy.
—वकव्रत-चर, अस्, m.
one who acts like a crane, a hypocrite.
—वक-व्र-
तिक, अस्, or वक-व्रतिन्, ई, m. ‘one whose acts or
observances are like those of a crane, ‘a false devotee,
religious hypocrite, one who assumes the appearance
of devotion or meditation for interested purposes,
(see वक-वृत्ति.)
—वक-सक्थ, अस्, m. a proper
N.; (आस्), m. pl. Vaka-saktha's descendants.
—वक-
सह-वासिन्, ई, m. ‘dwelling in the same abode as
the crane, ‘a lotus.
—वकारि (˚क-अरि), इस्, m.
‘enemy of Vaka,’ N. of Kṛṣṇa.
—वकेश (˚क-
ईश), अस्, m., N. of a temple founded by Vaka.

वाक 1. वाक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. वक; for 2. वाक
see col. 3), belonging or relating to a crane; (अम्),
n. a flight of cranes.

2. वाक, अस्, आ, अम्, sounding, speaking (at the
end of some comps., cf. चक्र-व्˚, चीरी-व्˚).
वकाची, f. a sort of fish (= वक-चिञ्चिका).

वकाय, Nom. P. वकायति, &c., to represent or
act like the Asura Vaka.
वकायत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, acting like the Asura Vaka.

वकुल, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. वक् or वङ्क्),
a kind of tree, Mimusops Elengi; a kind of drug;
(आ), f., N. of a plant, = कटुका; (ई), f. a sort of
drug (commonly called Kākolī); (अम्), n. the fra-
grant flower of Mimusops Elengi.
—वकुलावलिका
(˚ल-आव्˚), f., N. of a woman.
वकुल वकुल. See col. 2.
वकूल, अस्, m. the Vakula tree.
वक्कुल वक्कुल, अस्, m. a proper N.

वाकुल वाकुल, अम्, n. (fr. वकुल), scil.
फल, the fruit of the Vakula tree.

वकुलित, अस्, आ, अम्, furnished with Mimusops
Elengi.

वकेरुका, f. a small crane; the branch of a tree
bent by the wind.
वकोट, अस्, m. a crane.

वक्र, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked, winding, tortuous,
curved, bent, bowed, meandering, curled, curly (as
hair &c.); having an apparently backward motion,
retrograde (said of planets); prosodially long (the
form of the long mark being supposed to be curved),
crooked in disposition, cunning, fraudulent, dishonest,
prevaricating, indirect, evasive, ambiguous; cruel,
malignant; (अस्), m. the planet Mars; the planet
Saturn; Rudra or Śiva; the Asura Tripura; N. of
a king of the Karūṣas; of a Rākṣasa; = पर्पट;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a people, (also read चक्र); (आ),
f., N. of a particular musical instrument; scil. गति,
N. of a particular variation in the course of Mercury;
(अम्), n. the winding course of a river, the arm or
bend of a stream; the apparent retrograde motion
of a planet; (in surgery) a form of fracture (when a
bone is bent in a particular way or only partially
broken); [cf. according to some, Lat. varus: Hib.
fiar, ‘crooked, wicked;’ fiaras, ‘crookedness;’ fia-
raim, ‘I incline, bend.’]
—वक्र-कण्ट, अस्, m.
‘having crooked thorns,’ the jujube tree.
—वक्र-
कण्टक, अस्, m. Acacia Catechu.
—वक्र-खड्ग
or वक्र-खड्गक, अस्, m. a bent sword, a cimeter,
sabre.
—वक्र-गति, इस्, f. crooked or winding course,
tortuous motion, apparent retrograde motion or re-
trogression (said of the course of Mars &c.); (इस्, इस्,
इ), moving crookedly or tortuously, meandering.
—वक्र-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going crookedly, moving
tortuously or in zigzag, fraudulent, dishonest.
—व-
क्र-ग्रीव, अस्, m. ‘crooked-necked,’ a camel.
—व-
क्र-चञ्चु, उस्, m. ‘crooked-beaked,’ a parrot.
—वक्र-ता, f. or वक्र-त्व, अम्, n. crookedness,
curvature, curvedness, tortuousness; retrograde motion
(in astronomy); the going crooked or wrong, failure,
mishap; perverseness, falseness, dishonesty, ambi-
guity, prevarication.
—वक्र-तुण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्,
crooked-beaked, having a crooked face; (अस्), m. a
parrot; N. of Gaṇeśa (so called as represented with
the trunk of an elephant).
—वक्र-दंष्ट्र, अस्,
m. ‘crooked-tusked,’ a boar, (wrongly read वक्त्र-
द्˚.)
—वक्र-दृष्टि, इस्, f. oblique vision, an
[]
oblique look, squint; malignant regard, hostile view;
(इस्, इस्, इ), looking asquint, squint-eyed, squinting;
looking malignantly or with an evil eye at any one;
jealous, envious.
—वक्र-नक्र, अस्, m. ‘crooked-
beaked, ‘a parrot; a low or depraved man.
—वक्र-
नाल, अम्, n. a sort of wind-instrument.
—वक्र-
नास, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked-nosed, having a crooked
beak; (अस्), m. a proper N.
—वक्र-नासिक, अस्,
m. ‘crooked-nosed,’ an owl.
—वक्र-पाद, अस्, आ,
अम्, crooked-legged.
—वक्र-पुच्छ or वक्र-
पुच्छिक, अस्, m. ‘crooked-tailed,’ a dog.
—वक्र-
पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
—वक्र-पुष्प, अस्,
m., N. of a plant, Sesbana Grandiflora; Butea Fron-
dosa.
—वक्र-बालधि, इस्, m. ‘crooked-tailed,’ a
dog.
—वक्र-भणित, अम्, n. indirect speech,
equivocation, prevarication, evasion.
—वक्र-भाव,
अस्, m. the state of being bent, curvature, crooked-
ness; cunning, craft, deceit.
—वक्र-रेखा, f. a
curved line.
—वक्र-लाङ्गूल, अम्, n. a crooked
tail; (अस्), m. ‘crooked-tailed,’ a dog.
—वक्र-
वक्त्र, अस्, m. ‘crooked-faced, having a crooked
snout, ‘a hog, boar.
—वक्र-शल्या, f. a kind of
small shrub or bush.
—वक्र-शृङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम्,
having crooked or bent horns.
—वक्र-संस्थ,
अस्, आ, अम्, placed transversely.
—वक्राग्र (˚र-
अग्˚), अम्, n., N. of a plant (commonly called Bétu).
—वक्राङ्ग (˚र-अङ्˚), अम्, n. a crooked limb;
(अस्), m. a goose; the ruddy goose (‘having a curved
body’); a snake.
—वक्राङ्घ्रि (˚र-अङ्˚), इस्, m.
a crooked leg.
—वक्री-करण, अम्, n. the act of
making crooked, bending, distorting.
—वक्री-कृ,
cl. 8. P. -करोति, -कर्तुम्, to make curved or crooked.
—वक्री-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, made crooked or curved,
bent.
—वक्री-भाव, अस्, m. curvature, curve;
fraudulent or dishonest disposition.
—वक्री-भू, cl.
1. P. -भवति, &c., to become crooked or bent;
to retrograde (said of planets).
—वक्री-भूत, अस्, आ,
अम्, become crooked, curved, bent, dishonest.
—व-
क्रेतर (˚र-इत्˚), अस्, आ, अत्, reverse of crooked,
straight, not curved or curled.
—वक्रोक्ति (˚र-उक्˚),
इस्, f. indirect or perverse speech, equivocation, pre-
varication, evasive speech or reply, evasion; hint,
insinuation; pun; sarcasm.
—वक्रोक्ति-जीवित, अम्,
n., N. of a work.
—वक्रोष्ठि, इस्, or वक्रोष्ठिका,
f. (fr. वक्र + ओष्ठ), a slight smile, one in which
the lips are drawn on one side without the teeth
being shewn.
वक्र वक्र, &c. See col. 2.
वक्रतु, उस्, m., N. of a deity.

वक्रातप, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people, (also read
चक्राति.)

वक्रि, इस्, इस्, इ, equivocating, speaking falsely,
uttering untruths, prevaricating, lying.

वक्रित, अस्, आ, अम्, curved, crooked, bent; entering
on an apparently retrograde course (said of a planet).

वक्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, crooked; retrograding, moving
backwards (said of Mars and other planets); dis-
honest, fraudulent; (ई), m. a Jaina or Bauddha.
वक्रिम, अस्, आ, अम्, bent, curved.

वक्रिमन्, आ, m. crookedness, curvature; crafti-
ness, cunning, duplicity, ambiguity.

वक्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. winding about, moving
crookedly, rolling, hastening.
वकल वकल, अस्, m., Ved. inner rind, bast.
वकसुहाण वकसुहाण, N. of a place.

वकुश वकुश, अस्, m., N. of a particular
animal dwelling in the foliage of trees.

वक्कलिन् वक्कलिन्, ई, m. (formed fr. वल्-
कलिन्), N. of a Ṛṣi.
वक्कस वक्कस = वक्वस.
वक्तव्य वक्तव्य, वक्त्र. See p. 877, col. 3.

वक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken or uttered, fit
or proper to be said; to be named or called; to be
spoken to or addressed; to be spoken about or
against, having a bad name or reputation, blam-
able, reprehensible, vile, low, base, bad; liable to be
called upon for an account, answerable, accountable,
responsible; subject, dependent; (अम्), n. a rule,
precept, sentence, dictum, aphorism, speech; speak-
ing; reproach, censure.
—वक्तव्य-ता, f. or वक्-
तव्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being fit or proper
to be said or spoken about, the state of being spoken
against, the having a bad name or reputation, re-
proachableness, blamableness, reprehension, blame;
responsibility; subjection, dependence.

वक्रम व-क्रम, अस्, m. (for अव-क्रम),
flight, retreat.

वक्रय व-क्रय, अस्, m. (for अव-क्रय,
q. v.), price.

वक्रोलक वक्रोलक, अस्, m., N. of a village;
(अम्), n., N. of a town.
वक्वन् वक्वन्. See p. 878, col. 1.

वक्वन्, आ, -वरी, अ, Ved. (according to modern
scholars) = वक्व, p. 876, col. 3; (आ), m. a speaker,
singer, chanter, great talker, chatterer.

वक्वस वक्वस, अस्, m. a particular intoxi-
cating drink.

वक्ष् वक्ष् (closely connected with rt.
2. उक्ष्, q. v.), cl. 1. P. (Ved. also A.)
वक्षति, ववक्ष, (in the Veda only the follow-
ing Perfect forms are found, ववक्ष, ववक्षि-
थ, ववक्षुस्, ववक्षे, ववक्षिरे), वक्षि-
तुम्, Ved. to grow, increase, become tall; to accu-
mulate; to be great or strong, to be powerful, (ac-
cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 64, 3. ववक्षुः =
प्रापयितुम् इच्छन्ति, they wish to bring; II. 22,
3. ववक्षिथ = वोढुम् इच्छसि, thou desirest to
support, as if fr. rt. 1. वह्); to be angry: Caus.
वक्षयति, &c., Ved. to make grow, cause to
increase, cause to be strong; [cf. Zend ukhs, ‘to
grow:’ Gr. αὔξ-ω, αὐξ-άν-ω, αὔξ-η, αὔξ-η-σι-ς,
αὔξ-η-μα: Lat. vas-tus: Goth. vahs-ja, vahs-tu-s:
Angl. Sax. weaxan: Lith. augu, auks-tas: Hib.
fasaim, ‘I grow;’ fasamhuil, ‘growing.’]

वक्षण, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. (perhaps) strengthen-
ing, refreshing; (अम्), n. the breast; (perhaps)
refreshment, strengthening, (according to Sāy. on
Ṛg-veda VI. 23, 6. वक्षणानि = वाहकानि स्तो-
त्राणि, as if fr. rt. 1. वह्); fire (according to Sāy.
on Ṛg-veda V. 19, 5); (आस्), f. pl. the stomach,
abdomen, interior, (perhaps connected with rt.
1. वह्); the sides, flank; the bed of a river; (ac-
cording to Naigh. I. 13) = नदी, a river.
—वक्-
षणे-स्था, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. being in fire, (Sāy. =
वह्नौ स्थित.)

वक्षणि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (perhaps) strengthening,
making strong.

वक्षथ, अस्, m., Ved. the act of strengthening,
invigorating; growing, increasing; growth.

वक्षस्, अस्, n. (according to some originally
पक्षस्), strength (Ved.); the breast, bosom, chest,
(in this sense perhaps fr. rt. 1. वह्); (आस्), m. an
ox, bullock; [cf. perhaps Lat. pectus; Hib. uchd,
‘the breast.’]
—वक्षः-सम्मर्दिनी, f. a wife (as
pressing or reclining on her husband's breast).
—वक्-
षः-स्थल or वक्षस्-स्थल, अम्, n. the place of
the breast, the breast, bosom, heart.
—वक्षस्-तटा-
घात (˚ट-आघ्˚), अस्, m. a blow on the chest; [cf.
तट.]
—वक्षो-ग्रीव, अस्, m., N. of a son of
Viśvā-mitra.
—वक्षो-ज, अस्, m. or औ, m. du.
‘chest-born,’ the female breast; [cf. उरो-ज.]
—वक्-
षो-मण्डलिन्, ई, m., scil. हस्त, a position of the
hands in dancing.
—वक्षो-रुह्, ट्, or वक्षो-रुह,
अस्, m. ‘chest-growing,’ the female breast.

वक्षी, f., Ved. (according to Sāy.) flame; [cf.
वक्षण above.]
वक्षु वक्षु, the Oxus.
वक्ष्यमाण वक्ष्यमाण. See p. 878, col. 1.

वक्ष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, about to be said or
described, intended to be spoken about afterwards,
to be mentioned hereafter or subsequently.
—वक्ष्-
यमाण-त्व, अम्, n. the being about to be men-
tioned, the being about to be spoken of hereafter.
वक्ति, इस्, f., Ved. speech; [cf. उक्ति.]

वक्तु, उस्, m. (according to Sāy. = परुष-
वाक्यानां वक्तृ), a speaker of harsh language,
reviler; (but according to modern scholars वक्तवे
in Ṛg-veda VII. 31, 5. is a Vedic infin.)

वक्तु-काम, अस्, आ, अम् (वक्तु for वक्तुम्), in-
tending to speak, desirous of speaking, about to speak.

वक्तु-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (वक्तु for वक्तुम्),
having a mind to speak, being about to speak.

वक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who speaks, a speaker;
speaking, saying, loquacious, talkative; speaking
well or sensibly, eloquent, learned, wise; speaking
truly, honest, sincere; (ता), m. a speaker, orator,
expounder, teacher; [cf. Lat. auctor.]
—वक्तृ-ता,
f. or वक्तृ-त्व, अम्, n. ability to speak, talkative-
ness, eloquence, elocution.
—वक्तृत्व-शक्ति, इस्, f.
ability to speak, eloquence.

वक्तृक, अस्, आ, अम्, at the end of an adj. comp.
= वक्तृ.

वक्त्र, अम्, n. the organ of speech, the mouth;
the face; a muzzle, snout, proboscis, beak, &c.; the
point (of an arrow), the spout of a jug or vessel;
beginning, commencement; (in algebra) the initial
quantity or first term of a progression; a sort of
metre containing four times eight syllables (said to
be like the श्लोक); a sort of garment; the root of
Tabernæmontana Coronaria; [cf. perhaps Lat. la-
trare for vactrare.]
—वक्त्र-खुर, अस्, m. ‘mouth-
hoof, ‘a tooth.
—वक्त्र-ज, अस्, m. ‘sprung from
the mouth (of Brahmā), ‘a Brāhman.
—वक्त्र-
ताल, अम्, n. a musical instrument played with the
mouth; (said to mean also ‘making a noise by strik-
ing the mouth with the hand at the moment of utter-
ing sound.’)
—वक्त्र-तुण्ड, अस्, m. ‘having a pro-
boscis instead of a face, ‘N. of Gaṇeśa.
—वक्त्र-
दल, अम्, n. a part of the mouth, the palate.
[]
—वक्त्र-द्वार, अम्, n. the opening of the mouth.
—वक्त्र-पट, a veil.
—वक्त्र-पट्ट, अस्, m. a
bag containing corn tied round a horse's head.
—वक्त्र-परिस्पन्द, अस्, m. ‘motion of the
mouth, ‘speech, discourse.
—वक्त्र-भेदिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, mouth-piercing, mouth-cutting, pungent, bitter,
sharp.
—वक्त्र-योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting with the
mouth; (ई), m., N. of an Asura.
—वक्त्र-रन्-
ध्र, अम्, n. the aperture of the mouth.
—वक्त्र-
रुह, ‘growing on the face,’ hair growing on
the face, hair on the proboscis (of elephants &c.).
